import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); g=G['Demo pair 1 input']; tt=G['Demo pair 1 output']; h,w=20,20; hr,vc=5,7
F=[(r-hr,c-vc) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==0 and tt[r][c]==4]
M_=[(r-hr,c-vc) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==0 and tt[r][c]==0]
preds={
 '(v-u) even': lambda v,u:(v-u)%2==0,
 'min(|v|,|u|) even': lambda v,u:min(abs(v),abs(u))%2==0,
 'max(|v|,|u|) even': lambda v,u:max(abs(v),abs(u))%2==0,
 '(|v|+|u|)//2 even': lambda v,u:((abs(v)+abs(u))//2)%2==0,
 '((|v|+|u|)) even': lambda v,u:(abs(v)+abs(u))%2==0,
 '(|v|-|u|) even': lambda v,u:(abs(v)-abs(u))%2==0,
}
for n_,kf in preds.items():
    nf=sum(1 for v,u in F if kf(v,u)); nm_=sum(1 for v,u in M_ if kf(v,u))
    print(n_, nf,'/',len(F),'misses', len(M_)-nm_)
